highlights: Bi-directional SFE Institution Approval synchronization between HCP Profiling Mobile App and Territory Reconfiguration Web Portal
Frappe Comment query updated to descending order (order_by=creation desc) with chronological priority to ensure recent rejections are never clipped by pagination
Bi-directional cache reconciliation: linked HCP Accounts, Doctors, and HCP Profile Submissions with rejection notes back-propagate to local institution records
System lockscreen and heads-up pop-up notification delivery for MedRep users when proposed institutions are rejected by SFE
Prominent red rejection badges and callout notices displayed across Institution Directory and Institution Submission screens
